# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML is a bilingual 12-engine website diagnosis and implementation-mandate platform. Evidence-backed public findings are free; the implementation contract is the paid product.

HTML&HTML separates measured facts, official standards, vendor guidance, proposals, internal heuristics and experimental agent surfaces. Public scanning never invents source-file paths and never fabricates field Core Web Vitals.

## Core product

- [Website Evidence Validator](https://htmlandhtml.com/): Free diagnosis across Crawl & Index, Technical SEO, AI crawler access, formal llms.txt v2 verification, Structured Data, Performance Hygiene, Accessibility, Security, Content Trust, Agent Readiness, Conversion and Link Integrity.
- [Machine-readable product overview](https://htmlandhtml.com/index.md): Clean Markdown overview of the product, evidence boundary and commercial model.

## Engineering guide

- [llms.txt v2 and AI readiness guide](https://htmlandhtml.com/guide.md): Current v2 structure, path-specific discovery, crawler-role separation, evidence classes and release gates.
- [Methodology and evidence policy](https://htmlandhtml.com/about.md): How HTML&HTML distinguishes measured evidence, standards, vendor policies, proposals, heuristics and deliberate non-claims.

## Developer resources

- [API documentation](https://htmlandhtml.com/api): Human-readable documentation for the scan, formal llms audit, health and paid mandate endpoints.
- [Formal llms.txt audit API](https://htmlandhtml.com/api/llms): GET or POST endpoint that prefers the most-specific applicable llms.txt, parses its structure and probes declared file-list links.
- [Full public scan API](https://htmlandhtml.com/api/scan): POST endpoint for the 12-engine evidence report.
- [Health endpoint](https://htmlandhtml.com/api/health): Runtime engine, registry and llms.txt rule-set health contract.

## Commercial model

- [Full Site Fix Mandate](https://htmlandhtml.com/#pricing): USD 149 for one domain / one engagement. A fresh scan is converted into P0–P3 implementation order, ROOT FIX, RECOVERY, PREVENTION, acceptance/falsification and regression tests, rollback and stop conditions.

## Important interpretation notes

- 100/100 means only that measured checks passed. It does not guarantee rankings, traffic, sales or AI citations.
- llms.txt v2 is a proposal. HTML&HTML does not treat its absence as a Google Search ranking failure.
- Public scanning verifies externally visible behavior but cannot reliably name the source file that must change. File-level targeting requires source/codebase context.
- Reliable field LCP, INP and CLS require appropriate field/lab evidence. If unavailable, those metrics remain NOT_MEASURED.
- Search/retrieval crawler controls are evaluated separately from model-training or product-control tokens.
